1.e4 e5 2.f4 exf4 3.Nf3 g5 4.Bc4 d6 5.O-.strategy: Puts the question to the bishop at once: it can trade itself for the knight, retreat or be supported. If Black trades, White recaptures with the queen or the rook and attacks f4 along the f-file; if the bishop retreats, White has gained space on the kingside.

Supports the bishop with a pawn instead of trading or retreating. If White takes on g4, ...hxg4 gives up a bishop for a pawn but opens the h-file against the king and attacks the knight. A bold, double-edged choice: Black plays for the attack at the cost of material.
